name: unslop
purpose: Inspect actual artifacts against scoped evolving criteria without inferring authorship or grading missing evidence as pass.

criteria.description: Inspect the actual artifact at the relevant revision and surface.
Use the current scoped catalog with evidence-backed reasoning rather than authorship guesses.
Preserve legitimate exceptions and objective correctness/accessibility floors.

native_show.description: Use the actual scoped anti-slop show; recorded observations do not replace artifact inspection.

native_grade.description: Use the actual scoped anti-slop grade; recorded observations do not replace artifact inspection.

native_check.description: Use the actual scoped anti-slop check; recorded observations do not replace artifact inspection.

limits: Mechanical verification checks recorded facts and actual retained bytes; a recorded semantic inspection is not authenticated judgment.
Compilation and fixture success do not prove complete semantic workflow performance or provider/native-host activation.
Use the native catalog/grade path and actual artifact inspection. This shared gate does not produce or authenticate an anti-slop quality score.
